caption: The drawing depicts the back view of a long-sleeved dress rendered in black ink on a beige or off-white background. The dress features a rounded neckline decorated with a scalloped edge. The sleeves are full and gathered at the shoulders and cuffs. The back of the dress is gathered at the waist, creating volume in the skirt. The skirt is long and flares out, and it is decorated with two parallel horizontal bands of scalloped trim near the hem. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the lines are precise and delicate. No other objects or details are present on the plain background.
